method: POST https://tx.main.fastnear.com/v0/account with is_signer true and the block-height window, then POST /v0/transactions in batches of 20. Each body is joined to the request by transaction.hash and classified by the same Delegate rule as matchRpcTx: one outer Delegate, receiver NEAR USDC, one inner ft_transfer, one successful USDC receipt. is_real_signer is not the relayer filter.

sources: https://github.com/fastnear/x402-facilitator/blob/main/docs/evidence/2026-07-19-relayer-provisioning.md (mainnet account created; that note says the service was not shown live)
https://api.solvador.com/supported (signers['near:*'] is solvador.near; kind exact on near:mainnet, retrieved 2026-11-07)
https://docs.solvador.com/networks/ (NEAR exact is a relayer-sponsored NEP-366 delegate)

https://facilitator.ultravioletadao.xyz/supported (v2 exact near:mainnet extra.feePayer, retrieved 2026-11-07; not a row in the foundation facilitators table; the same host also advertises an escrow scheme, which this count leaves out)
data/snapshot/near/usdc-delegate-sample.json (signer_id of every frozen delegate-shaped hit, including 76hZkqNNi359kH266MTbce7ko9nvcqwMaWjtw92Azc4b). Not named by a facilitator /supported response.

limits: On the relayer's /v0/account row, a delegate settlement has is_signer true and is_real_signer false. is_real_signer true on that same hash is the payer, the delegate sender. Filtering the relayer with is_real_signer drops the settlements. This count lists is_signer and then opens the transaction.

The list row has no actions. Every signer transaction in the window is opened. A transaction counts only when matchRpcTx accepts it: one Delegate, receiver NEAR USDC, one inner ft_transfer, and the USDC receipt succeeded. Exactly one USDC execution outcome is required.
The sum is a lower bound on N. A relayer this survey did not name is absent. Delegate transfers signed by an account that is not in this file are absent. N also includes transfers that are not x402.
The window is closed at the tip block read when the census started. Blocks after that tip are outside it. Block time is the FastNEAR block timestamp, not a clock on this machine.
x402-relayer2.mike.near is the signer named by the FastNEAR reference config and by the live x402.mikedotexe.com /supported response. Those are one account, counted once.
solvador.near and uvd-facilitator.near are the signer or fee payer their public /supported responses name. An escrow scheme on the same host is not this count.
x402-relayer.mike.near was provisioned as a mainnet relayer. The provisioning note says that record is not evidence the service was live. The live signer is x402-relayer2.mike.near.

POST /v0/transactions does not return bodies in tx_hashes order. Counts join each body to transaction.hash. A batch whose length matches can still be a permutation of the request, so a position join can total the same and label a different hash. sample_hashes are the earliest hashes counted by that join.

uvd-facilitator.near's signer transactions in the window are escrow calls on v1.arras-escrow.near and ft_transfer_call to NEAR USDC. ft_transfer_call is not the single ft_transfer this count accepts. The escrow scheme on that host is not this count.
x402-relayer.mike.testnet is the signer at test.x402.mikedotexe.com. It is not a mainnet account and is not in this sum.
